name: Lip Trill Coach
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Trains lip trills, tongue trills and straw phonation (SOVT) - the cornerstone of modern vocal warm-up and therapy. Detects the buzzy amplitude flutter of a trill (~20-35 Hz), scores its rate, regularity and carrier-pitch steadiness, and turns it into a bubble tube: smooth dense bubbles when the trill is even, stuttering bubbles when it sputters. A hold timer rewards sustaining a clean trill.
